product.name: IVAR cabinet
product.introText: IVAR cabinet, solid pine, 80x30x83 cm, 2 doors, 2 shelves. Assembly instructions AA-2272100-5. Tools: Phillips screwdriver and the Allen key. Free-standing version (no IVAR side units).
product.partsSummary: 1x Allen key,  1x Back,  1x Bottom,  8x Confirmat,  2x Door,  8x Dowel,  4x Hinge,  8x Hinge screw,  4x Mount plate,  8x Plate screw,  2x Shelf,  8x Shelf pin,  2x Side,  1x Top

steps.title: Dowels
steps.text: Tap 2 wooden dowels into each end of the top and the bottom panel (8 in total).

steps.title: First side panel
steps.text: Lay the first side panel down with the front edge on the floor. Fit the top and the bottom panel onto it with their dowels, then fix them with 4 screws using the Allen key.

steps.title: Back panel
steps.text: Slide the back panel into the grooves of the top and the bottom panel, smooth side facing into the cabinet, all the way to the first side.

steps.title: Second side panel
steps.text: Fit the second side panel onto the dowels and fix it with 4 screws using the Allen key.

steps.title: Mounting plates
steps.text: Stand the cabinet up. Screw 2 hinge mounting plates onto the inside of each side panel, at the front holes (2 screws each).

steps.title: Hinges into the doors
steps.text: Lay the doors face down. Press a hinge cup into each of the 4 holes and fix each hinge with 2 screws.

steps.title: Shelves
steps.text: Push 4 shelf supports into the side holes at the height you want for each shelf and lay the 2 shelves on them. (Done here before hanging the doors, so the opening is free.)

steps.title: Hang the doors
steps.text: Hook each hinge onto its mounting plate and press until it clicks, then tighten the screw. Adjust height, depth and side gap with the hinge screws (page 19). Always anchor the cabinet to the wall (page 10) - wall fixings are not included.
